definitions.explanation: Two occurrences or repetitions of an action. Formed from {二|に} (two) + the counter {回|かい} (times). Used for counting how many times something happens or is done.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧{二回|にかい}⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take medicine twice a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二回|にかい}、⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}って→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I go to the gym and work out twice a week.

notes:
⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧ + the general counter ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ (times, occurrences). ⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧ is the most versatile counter for repeated actions; it can substitute for ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ in most cases and is preferred from {四回|よんかい} onward.

WATCH OUT:
Identical pronunciation to ⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧ (second floor). Context usually makes the meaning clear, but be careful in speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二回|にかい}: twice a day
- ⟦{週|しゅう}→週：03204_shuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二回|にかい}: twice a week
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二回|にかい}: twice a month
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二回|にかい}: twice a year
- {二回|にかい}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: the second time

COUNTING WITH {回|かい}:
- ⟦{一回|いっかい}→一回：08925_ikkai⟧: once
- {二回|にかい}: twice
- ⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧: three times
- {四回|よんかい}: four times
- ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧: how many times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧: twice (somewhat literary; often used for emphasis as in ⟦{二度|にど}と→二度と：06482_nidoto⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ 'never again')
